statement: Let visitors discover coding challenges and let local learners edit, run, submit, review, save, and track solutions without contacting HackerRank or causing production effects.

actors.description: Anonymous visitor browsing public practice, challenge, contest, and support pages.
Authenticated local account that edits solutions and tracks challenge progress.

simulations: Code runs use deterministic local fixtures and never execute untrusted source-site jobs.
Registration and password recovery use the local-only WebsiteBench mail outbox.
Submissions, scores, runtime, memory, badges, streaks, and contest status are deterministic local records.
out_of_scope: Real email delivery, external identity providers, SSO, and source-account access
Live code execution, remote judging, hidden HackerRank test data, proctoring, and employer assessments
Messaging other users, publishing discussions, and changing production data
Billing, subscriptions, checkout, payment credentials, and payments
Direct source fidelity claims for pages blocked by HTTP 403
Any runtime request to hackerrank.com or another external service
